ArtifactEvidence.description: A checksummed artifact and optional evidence of its installed contents.

installed_wheel.description: Exact installed wheel files and paths checked within the monitored codebase.

oneOf.description: Path relative to the selected codebase.
Path relative to the monitor profile's directory.

line_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the line without its line ending.

Assessment.description:
`not_applicable`: a security claim that, per the cited source, does not affect the monitored
version or build. It requires `not_applicable_reason`, is counted and remembered, and opens no case.

BlockerKind.description:
Why a sandbox check the case needs cannot run. Missing deployment facts are not a kind: the
sandbox cannot establish them, so they never require a check.

oneOf.description: The advisory or report does not disclose enough to build an oracle.
The exact artifact cannot be obtained from an official source with a checksum.
The artifact or workload exceeds the profile's sandbox limits or their caps.
Microsandbox cannot run on this host.
The operator declined to authorize the test.

codebase_revisions.description: Git codebases that bound the facts and review for this case.

matches.description: The recorded Git identity and available changed-file fingerprint match.

dirty.description: Changes excluding private paths, ignored files, generated untracked files and submodules.

worktree_status_sha256.description: Hash of Git's status entries and changed files, without retaining names or contents.

oneOf.description: An agent-only observation was subsequently found inapplicable.

deferred_transitive.description: Inventory instances outside the selected tracker-mapping scope.

sources_unavailable.description: Mapped components without a repository, so upstream research cannot cover them.

impact_reassessment_required.description: A recorded impact cannot be reused and must be reassessed under the current questions.

open_challenges.description: Challenges awaiting a new verdict; reviewer independence is not verified.

review_handoff.description: Evidence-bound review disposition; it never represents a sandbox attestation.

review_handoff_stale.description: A prior disposition is no longer current or its evidence cannot be validated.

provenance.description: Where each component version was read: `codebase/path:line`, or the profile.

recorded_verdict.description: Latest recorded agent verdict (`decision: rationale`), when one exists.

source_facts.description: What the cited upstream items state (affected versions, fix, required feature).

absent_paths.description: Paths or bounded filename patterns relative to the installed directory checked for absence.

scope_complete.description: The source and note support this installation for every in-scope build using the instance.

scope_evidence_id.description: Case evidence describing why this directory represents the assessed build or test scope.

scope_source.description: Current source line supporting the scope described in the case evidence.

python_lock.description: Locally recorded pip lock hashes and dependency annotations, before registry verification.

release.description: Verified registry metadata for this exact resolved version, when available.

blocker.description: Set for a `blocked` result; absent for blockers recorded without a kind.

sandbox_candidate.description: An unconfirmed version warrants a review decision; it does not mandate a test.

sandbox_needed.description: A current review disposition explicitly requires a test for this instance.

versioned_purl.description: Canonical PURL with the resolved version, when both are known.

oneOf.description: The monitored resolved version already contains the fix.
Only other release lines or unreleased branches are affected.
The affected module, feature or platform is absent from the monitored build.
`vulnbell impact` has not been answered for the current case facts.
An unconfirmed signal needs an explicit review disposition, not necessarily a test.
A test was explicitly required and has neither a result nor a categorized blocker.
Recorded verification evidence could not be validated.

codebase_context_sha256.description: Fingerprint of the Git codebases reviewed with this inventory.

line.description:
1-based line in `path` where the package entry or cited excerpt starts.
Display-only: excluded from the context fingerprint so unrelated edits do not reopen cases.

codebase_revisions.description: Codebase revisions recorded by the CLI at import time.

reviewed_instance_ids.description: Candidate instances examined when choosing the case scope.

source_facts.description:
Answers to the research questions as the item states them. `fixed_in_monitored_version`
requires `fixed_in`, and `affects_other_version` requires `affected_versions`.

updated_at.description:
Original RFC3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD when the source provides only a date.
Empty means unknown. Unknown/day precision keeps coverage partial and never advances checkpoints.

evidence_gaps.description:
Missing, corrupt or undecodable evidence IDs; `agent_retraction_assessment:missing`
indicates that no retraction assessment was recorded.

ReviewHandoff.description: A reviewed case may be handed off with open uncertainty without requiring a laboratory test.

sandbox_instance_ids.description: Explicit test targets; empty only when no sandbox test is required.

SourceFacts.description:
What an upstream item itself states, quoted or closely paraphrased; an empty field means the
item does not say. These are the item's statements, not the agent's conclusions.

affected_versions.description: Versions or release lines the item says are affected.

fix_reference.description: Pull request, commit or release that carries the fix.

fixed_in.description: Version, release or backport the item says contains the fix.

identifiers.description: CVE, GHSA, RUSTSEC or other advisory IDs the item cites.

required_feature.description: Feature, configuration or deployment condition the item says the issue requires.

SourceLocation.description: An agent-reviewed codebase finding. Do not include credentials or source snippets.

codebase.description: Zero-based index in the latest scan's codebase revisions.

line_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the inspected line, excluding its line ending.

review_revision.description: Revision of the review that inspected this codebase.

analysis.description: Agent's evidence-bound reasoning; do not include code or credentials.

codebase.description: Zero-based index in the latest scan's codebase revisions.

evidence.description: Additional source locations that support the analysis; source content is not copied.

finding_id.description: Existing finding ID when reassessing or moving a previously recorded finding.

line_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the inspected line; null only when the former file was removed.

path.description: Codebase-relative path and one-based line; source content is not copied.

review_revision.description: Revision of the active code review whose source was inspected.

snapshot_id.description: ID of the scan the agent reviewed; stale submissions are rejected.

gaps.description: Unreviewed areas and their reason, without source snippets or secrets.

previous_revision.description: Last recorded review revision, or null when starting a new review.

scope.description: Concise reviewed areas or next work units, without source snippets or secrets.

uncertainties.description: Unresolved reachability or context questions within the reviewed scope.

closed_cases.description: Closed case details and evidence, regardless of Markdown detail mode.

code_findings.description: Agent-reviewed codebase findings, separate from dependency advisories.

code_reviews.description: Recorded independent codebase reviews; an absent entry means none was recorded.

codebase_revisions.description: Git identities recorded by the scan and the codebase state at report time.

language.description: Report language from the profile; the generated sentences in this report use it.

not_applicable_count.description: Recorded upstream non-applicability assessments, including cases later reopened.

retracted.description: Retracted cases and their recorded revisions, retained for audit.

schema_version.description: Current report contract distinguishes candidates from explicitly required checks.

verification_pending.description: Open cases whose verification is unfinished; a deliverable report requires none.
